infoLinks.urlText:
Leichhardt North Light Rail Lift between James St and the Light Rail stop is not available

ㅤ
infoLinks.content:
At Leichhardt North Light Rail Lift between James St and the Light Rail stop is temporarily out of service.
 
For your safety, do not use even if doors open.
 
Alternative access:
  • Use the stairs, if able to
  • Or use the opposite accessible entry/exit pathway via Charles Street.
 
For urgent assistance:
  • Use the Help Point if on the platform
  • Or call 131 500
